get.description:
Request Parameters

Attribute Type Description
metadata
companyId Integer Id of the company for which CDFs needs to be fetched
name String Name of the CDF if only a particular CDF needs to be fetched

Examples:

Retrieving CDFs for company_id : 42219

   
   GET https://apis-eu-west-1.lab.egencia.cloud/openconnect/api/v1/companies/42219/cdfs
       -> 200 OK
       {
           "cdfs": [
               {
                   "id": 27,
                   "name": "Main cost centre",
                   "code": "COST_CENTER_1",
                   "status": "ACTIVE",
                   "field_type": "LIST"
               },
               {
                   "id": 30,
                   "name": "Secondary cost centre",
                   "code": "COST_CENTER_2",
                   "status": "ACTIVE",
                   "field_type": "LIST"
               },
               {
                   "id": 1884,
                   "name": "Employee ID",
                   "code": "COST_CENTER_3",
                   "status": "ACTIVE",
                   "field_type": "FREE_FIELD"
               },
               {
                   "id": 31,
                   "name": "Free field 1",
                   "code": "BDC",
                   "status": "ACTIVE",
                   "field_type": "FREE_FIELD"
               }
           ]
       }

get.summary: Fetch all CDF definitions for a company or corresponding to a CDF name

get.description:
Request Parameters

Attribute Type Description
metadata
companyId Integer Id of the company
definitionId Integer Id of the CDF definition for which values needs to be fetched
value String CDF value to search based on display value/label
count Integer Count of CDF values to be fetched
start Integer Start to support pagination

Examples:

Successful response while retrieving CDF values for company_id : 42219 and definition_id : 27

   
   GET https://apis-eu-west-1.lab.egencia.cloud/openconnect/api/v1/companies/42219/cdfs/27/values?count=2&start=0
       -> 200 OK
       {
           "values": [
               {
                   "id": 84429607,
                   "value": "test A&B",
                   "description" : "test A&B"
               },
               {
                   "id": 84740706,
                   "value": "test AB",
                   "description" : "test AB"
               }
           ],
           "_links": {
               "next": {
                   "href": "https://apis-eu-west-1.lab.egencia.cloud/openconnect-service/v1/companies/42219/cdfs/27/values?count=2&start=2"
               }
           }
       }

Successful response to search CDF value : test for company_id : 42219 and definition_id : 27

   
   GET https://apis-eu-west-1.lab.egencia.cloud/openconnect/api/v1/companies/42219/cdfs/27/values?value=test
       -> 200 OK
       {
           "values": [
               {
                   "id": 83932305,
                   "value": "Testcc1",
                   "child_count":0
               },
               {
                   "id": 84429607,
                   "value": "testValue1",
                   "child_count":0
               },
               {
                   "id": 84429608,
                   "value": "testingCdf",
                   "child_count":0
               }
           ]
       }

Error response while retrieving CDF values for company_id : 42219 and definition_id : 1884

   
   GET https://apis-eu-west-1.lab.egencia.cloud/openconnect/api/v1/companies/42219/cdfs/1884/values?count=2&start=0
       -> 422 Unprocessable Entity
       {
           "error": {
               "code": "EGE-ER-OS-4006",
               "message": "CDF given in request has field type as free field."
           }
       }

Request Parameters

Attribute Type Description
metadata

definitionId Integer Id of the CDF definition for which values needs to be fetched
value String CDF value to search based on display value/label
count Integer Count of CDF values to be fetched
start Integer Start to support pagination
include_links Boolean Fetch CDF Links Flag

Examples:

Successful response while retrieving linked CDF values for company_id : 53092, definition_id : 27, value=84428977

               
               GET https://apis-eu-west-1.lab.egencia.cloud/openconnect/api/v1/companies/53092/cdfs/27/values/84428977?start=0&count=100&include_links=false
                   -> 200 OK
                   {
                       {
                         "id": 84428977,
                         "value": "Value 1",
                         "child_count": 4
                   }

Successful response to retrieve linked CDF value : test for company_id : 53092, definition_id : 27, value : 84428977

               
               GET https://apis-eu-west-1.lab.egencia.cloud/openconnect/api//v1/companies/53092/cdfs/27/values/84428977?start=0&count=100&include_links=true
                   -> 200 OK
                   {
                    {
                      "id": 84428977,
                      "value": "Value 1",
                      "child_count": 4,
                      "links": {
                       "child": [
                         {
                           "value": "Link with CC1 - 1",
